name: turtle-lsp-tests
description: End-to-end tests and benchmarks for the turtle-lsp Rust server

scripts.test: cargo build --release --locked && cargo test --release --locked && npm run test:node
scripts.test:vscode: cargo build --release --locked && cd editors/vscode && npm install --silent && npm test
scripts.corpus: tools/corpus/fetch.sh && cargo build --release --locked && cargo run --release --locked --example corpus && node tools/corpus/lsp-cost.mjs
scripts.web:test:browsers: for b in webkit firefox; do BROWSER=$b node --test --test-timeout=60000 web/test/browser.test.mjs web/test/editor.test.mjs || exit 1; done
